title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Candlelight flickers across rows of old books. The door is locked, and a small keypad glows next to the handle. Somewhere in this library is the way out...
room_description: A dusty private library at night. A single barred window lets in moonlight. You can see a writing desk, a large painting on the wall, a tall bookshelf, an antique globe and a heavy oak door with a keypad.

desk.name: desk
desk.description: An old writing desk with a green banker's lamp. A folded note lies on top, and the desk has a single drawer with a brass keyhole.

note.name: note
note.description: A folded note in neat handwriting. It reads: "Time hides behind the setting sun."

painting.name: painting
painting.description: An oil painting of a sunset over the sea. It hangs slightly crooked, as if it has been moved before.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key, slightly tarnished.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.description: A wooden desk drawer with a brass keyhole.

uv_flashlight.name: UV flashlight
uv_flashlight.description: A compact flashlight that gives off a faint violet glow when switched on. Ultraviolet light can reveal invisible ink.

torn_page.name: torn page
torn_page.description: A page torn from a poetry book. It reads: "Read the seasons as the poet does: Autumn, Winter, Spring, Summer."

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Tall shelves full of dusty volumes. Four books stand out from the rest: they are bound in matching leather and titled Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter.

season_books.name: season books
season_books.description: Four leather-bound books titled Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter. Their first pages look blank, but the paper has an odd, glossy sheen.

globe.name: globe
globe.description: An antique globe on a wooden stand, engraved with the words "Not all who wander are lost." It spins smoothly, but nothing seems hidden in it.

door.name: door
door.description: A heavy oak door. Next to the handle is a keypad that accepts a 4-digit code.

puzzles.find_key: Decode the note and find the brass key behind the painting
puzzles.open_drawer: Unlock the drawer with the brass key
puzzles.reveal_numbers: Reveal the hidden numbers in the season books with UV light
puzzles.unlock_door: Enter the correct code on the door keypad

hints.find_key: The note talks about a setting sun. Is there a sunset anywhere in this room?
hints.open_drawer: You have a key now. Which object in the room has a keyhole?
hints.get_light: The drawer is open. Have you taken everything inside it?
hints.reveal_numbers: The season books have a strange sheen. Some ink only shows up under a special kind of light.
hints.order_code: You have four numbers. The torn page tells you the order to read the seasons in.
hints.explore: Try examining everything in the room: the desk, the painting, the bookshelf, the globe and the door.
